newsitem.title: UK: Nelson field work delays N.Sea Forties cargo - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nelson field work delays N.Sea Forties cargo - trade.

text.p: Maintenance work at the North Sea's Nelson field has put back by a week the loading of a late June Forties cargo and could delay some of the July Forties programme, a trader said Friday.

The trader for a European major said he had been told his cargo loading June 29-July 1 would have to be delayed by seven days because of repair or maintenance work involving a compressor at the 160,000 barrel per day (bpd) field.
"That is also what's delaying the July programme," he added.
A spokesman for Britain's Enterprise Oil, which operates the field, said the field was at present in scheduled shutdown for maintenance in the first half of June.
The spokesman added he was unaware of any delays to loadings or any specific problem with a compressor but said any work on such equipment was probably part of the planned maintenance programme.
The spokesman said he expected the Nelson field to resume oil loading on or about June 17, with gas loading resuming about a week later.
